verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party dataset-creation API and no way to programmatically trigger an eval run and read back its results. The webhook docs mention scoring and evaluating responses, but that is scoring done by the user's own external system on request-completion callbacks, which is a developer building block rather than an eval-run capability. The request-query REST API and exporting logs to build datasets are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit for this story.
